content: Implement the canonical Linux udev policy for the existing MetaFlux cdev nodes /dev/metafluxctl and /dev/metafluxN, install the rule through the Daemon component, and add release-payload assertions without changing the kernel UAPI or creating vendor aliases.

Content revision 6839fa9e9eec2cd57fe43e813b29cda7b2cfaa96 adds packaging/common/70-metaflux.rules, installs it through the Daemon component, documents the kernel/udev node authority boundary, and adds complete-package and tar lifecycle assertions. The content commit was created with Agent Harness (codex) as Author and Committer.

Vulkan configure/build and .#vulkan-runtime CTest passed 91/91. The generic-release target configured and built through the Ubuntu 20.04 SDK with highest referenced glibc symbol GLIBC_2.29. Daemon install placed the rule at /usr/lib/udev/rules.d/70-metaflux.rules and both exact matches passed; Python compilation, records validation, and git diff --check passed. Checkpoint P20260831-085 records the node-policy boundary.

Closed the coherent W0123 node-policy stage at checkpoint P20260831-085. No session-owned disposable route or repository-local build output was created; external build trees remain under their existing owner, and foreign guidance inboxes remain with S01322/S01323.
